title: Strict-local models with a separably closed coefficient field and algebraic residue extensions
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $Y$ be a scheme of finite type over $K$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\bar y$ be a geometric point with underlying point $y$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $b=\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(y)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree], [def-weil-residue-field], and $S=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,\bar y}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. There exist an affine open neighbourhood $U$ of $y$ in $Y$, a separably closed field extension $L/K$ with $\operatorname{trdeg}_K L=b$ [def-kun-separably-closed], and a small cofiltered inverse system (the opposite index category is filtered as defined in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]) $(V_i\to U)$ of nonempty affine schemes with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism] over $U$ [def-pc-scheme], such that each $V_i$ is of finite type over $L$, the maps $V_i\to U$ are $K$-morphisms, and $S\cong\varprojlim_i V_i$ over $U$ (that is, the compatible maps $S\to V_i$ are universal among compatible cones). For every $i$ and every point $v\in V_i$ with image $u\in U$, the induced extension $\kappa(v)/\kappa(u)$ is algebraic (each element satisfies a nonzero polynomial over $\kappa(u)$). The transition morphisms are morphisms over $L$: if $p_i:V_i\to\operatorname{Spec}L$ is the structural map and $a:i\to j$ is an index arrow, then $V(a)\circ p_j=p_i$ (composition in diagram order).

proof.text: Choose the coefficient-compatible small filtered etale presentation E with colimit B, and a spectrum isomorphism from the original strict localization. Define S_i=L[image(E_i→B)] as actual L-subalgebras of B.

source.place: Tag 0F0U, lemma-strictly-henselian, proof before the compatible-model footnote; Tag 0F0X, lemma-interlude-I, second paragraph

proof.text: Naturality of the colimit legs makes S_i monotone along every arrow of the original filtered category. Every element of B lies in one S_i by a colimit representative. The structural map Gamma(U)→B lands in every S_i by the under-object equations. Finite generators for E_i over K have images generating S_i over L; the shared K-scalar equation proves this by algebra-adjoin induction. Etaleness of E_i over Gamma(U) and finite type of U over K supply the finite generators.

source.place: Tag 0F0U, lemma-strictly-henselian, proof before the compatible-model footnote; Tag 0F0X, lemma-interlude-I, second paragraph

proof.text: Build a ring diagram with objects S_i and transition maps the inclusions. Their cocone to B is colimiting: existence of representatives is exhaustivity and eventual equality follows from injectivity of the subtype maps. Spectrum sends this ring colimit to a scheme limit; the forgetful functor from Over U reflects that limit. Take the opposite of I for the cofiltered scheme diagram. Each transition inclusion S_i to S_j is an L-algebra map, so the spectrum transition commutes with the two maps to Spec L; expose this equation in the conclusion.

source.place: Tag 0F0U, lemma-strictly-henselian, proof before the compatible-model footnote; Tag 0F0X, lemma-interlude-I, second paragraph

proof.text: Each S_i is nonzero because it is a subring of nonzero B, so its spectrum is nonempty. Its spectrum is affine, its structural map to Spec L is of finite type, and transition maps are affine. Apply the coefficient-image residue theorem for algebraicity at every point. Assemble the cone and the original spectrum isomorphism; associativity verifies the required canonical structural-map equation.

lean.statement: theorem exists_strictLocal_algebraicResidue_models {K : Type u} [Field K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of K))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))] {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) : ∃ U : Y.Opens, s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L) (_ : IsSepClosed L), Algebra.trdeg K L = @Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) _ _ (((Y ↘ Spec (.of K)).residueFieldAlgebraMap (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))).toAlgebra) ∧ ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsCofiltered I) (D : I ⥤ Over U.toScheme) (p : ∀ i : I, (D.obj i).left ⟶ Spec (.of L)) (c : Cone D) (e : strictHenselizationScheme s ≅ c.pt.left), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ e.hom ≫ c.pt.hom ≫ U.ι = strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ∧ (∀ i : I, Nonempty (D.obj i).left ∧ IsAffine (D.obj i).left ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType (p i) ∧ QuasiCompact (p i) ∧ (D.obj i).hom ≫ U.ι ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (.of K)) = p i ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left) ∧ (∀ (i : I) (v : (D.obj i).left), @Algebra.IsAlgebraic (U.toScheme.residueField ((D.obj i).hom v)) ((D.obj i).left.residueField v) _ _ (((D.obj i).hom.residueFieldMap v).hom.toAlgebra)) ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), (D.map a).left ≫ p j = p i)
